## 赛道关键帧（Qwen Image 2.1 文生图）

每一行是一张关键帧。点一次 **运行** 生成全部 8 张，共消耗 8 个额度（30 步 = 1 个额度）。

图片保存在 `output/dream7/`，文件名形如 `K0_00001_.png`，每重新生成一次编号加 1。

**生成后对照分镜检查**：前方的路往哪边弯、离弯道多远，画面里该有的东西在不在。不对就改这张图提示词开头的场景描述（`Photorealistic onboard` 之前的部分），再点运行：ComfyUI 只会重新生成提示词改过的那张。节点没有随机种子，提示词不变时重新生成也是同一张图。

ComfyUI 重启后缓存会清空，点运行会把每张都重新生成；只想重做一张时，先选中其他行的 Save Image 节点，按 Ctrl+M 静音。

**定稿后复制到 input 目录**（镜头工作流会读取这些文件名）：

```
cp output/dream7/K0_00001_.png input/dream7_K0.png
cp output/dream7/K1_00001_.png input/dream7_K1.png
cp output/dream7/K2_00001_.png input/dream7_K2.png
cp output/dream7/K3_00001_.png input/dream7_K3.png
cp output/dream7/K4_00001_.png input/dream7_K4.png
cp output/dream7/K5_00001_.png input/dream7_K5.png
cp output/dream7/K6_00001_.png input/dream7_K6.png
cp output/dream7/K7_00001_.png input/dream7_K7.png
```

`00001` 换成你定稿的那一版。

The car is stationary on the starting grid, sitting exactly on the chequered start/finish line painted across a long, wide, dead-straight main straight. Close ahead, only about twenty metres in front of the car, a large start light gantry spans the full width of the track overhead and fills the upper part of the frame, its row of five big red lights lit and clearly visible. On the right side a large covered grandstand packed with spectators and a pit building with a pit wall. A red race car waits on the grid just ahead, slightly to the right, close to the gantry. The straight is very long, about one kilometre, and runs dead straight and almost level, falling very slightly, far beyond the red car and the gantry all the way to a vanishing point near the horizon: the white edge lines, kerbs and barrier walls stay straight and converge to that point, with no bend anywhere between the camera and the horizon. Only at the vanishing point itself, tiny and far away, a thin strip of blue barrier wall hints that the track will turn LEFT there. The ground around the far end is flat and low with grass run-off on both sides, and the road never climbs. Photorealistic onboard racing footage filmed by a T-cam mounted just above and behind the driver's helmet of a dark-blue open-wheel single-seater race car with a white nose. Only the halo safety bar, the top of the cockpit and the front wing tips are visible at the bottom of the frame; the camera height and framing never change. Sunny afternoon, clear blue sky, warm consistent sunlight. Grey asphalt circuit with white edge lines, red-and-white striped kerbs on every corner, green grass run-off, blue barrier walls, rolling green hills and scattered trees in the distance. Cinematic, sharp, natural colours, 16:9. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermark.
